query:
SELECT id, file_id, folder_id, share_token, permissions as "permissions: SharePermissions", password_hash,
                   expires_at, upload_only, access_count, recipient_user_id, recipient_group_id, created_by,
                   created_at, revoked_at, tenant_id
            FROM shares
            WHERE tenant_id = $2
              AND (recipient_user_id = $1 OR recipient_group_id IN (
                  SELECT gm.group_id
                  FROM group_members gm
                  JOIN users u ON u.id = gm.user_id
                  JOIN user_groups g ON g.id = gm.group_id AND g.tenant_id = $2
                  WHERE gm.user_id = $1 AND u.tenant_id = $2
              ))
              AND revoked_at IS NULL
              AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW())
              AND (
                  (file_id IS NOT NULL AND folder_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM files f
                      WHERE f.id = shares.file_id
                        AND f.tenant_id = $2
                        AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ))
                  OR
                  (folder_id IS NOT NULL AND file_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1 FROM folders f
                      WHERE f.id = shares.folder_id
                        AND f.tenant_id = $2
                        AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
                  ))
              )
            ORDER BY created_at DESC
            LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
